name: First Spring Under Heaven (天下第一泉)
verdict: 'First Spring Under Heaven' (Baotu Spring) scenic-area brand promoted on the shirt front; the scenic area is managed and operated by Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group, whose 93.19% shareholder and actual controller is the Jinan municipal SASAC. New front sponsor of Shandong Taishan for the 2026 CSL season.

why.text: The 'First Spring Under Heaven' scenic area advertised on the shirt front is managed and operated by Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group, whose largest shareholder and actual controller (93.19%) is the Jinan municipal state-assets commission. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations were committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So the money behind the shirt front is the Chinese state's.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China’s large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.

note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of Shandong Taishan in the 2026 Chinese Super League season (named press: Tencent News / 九五体育, 2026-03-17; the shirt advertises the club's owner-linked 'First Spring Under Heaven' scenic area — Baotu Spring).
